Source: Lattice 'ECP5U caBGA381 Pin Migration' CSV rev 1.1 (sources/lattice/sources.json id MIG381). Only connected balls of U18 are compared. **The 85F is not selected.** Pad-name changes (e.g. PL23A -> PL35A) matter only to the LPF/bitstream, which must be rebuilt for the 85F device anyway (different IDCODE 0x41113043, the loader rejects cross-device images, FIT X01).
